title: Juvenile Recurrent Respiratory Papillomatosis: Establishment of a French National Cohort (PRR : National Cohort " REPA ")
official: Juvenile Recurrent Respiratory Papillomatosis: Establishment of a French National Cohort (PRR : National Cohort " REPA ")
summary: Recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP) is a rare disease. However, it is the most common benign laryngeal tumor in children. To date, no epidemiological data are available in France. The aim of this study is to establish the epidemiology of juvenile PPR.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with juvenile PRR (disease onset before age 18)
* Followed in the :

  * The MALO CRMR
  * One of the MALO network's CCMRs
  * One of the main correspondent centers

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients objecting to the collection of their personal data
* Parents of minor patients objecting to the collection of their child's personal data
